name: claude-mind-manager
description: Region-based context management for Claude Code. 7 skills: mind-claudemd, mind-memory, mind-rules, mind-files, mind-update, mind-session-log, mind-compact (NEW v3.3.0). 2 agents (context-analyzer with knowledge-sync mode + project-scanner), 1 hook (PreCompact). v3.3.0: 4 parallel per-area agents in mind-update + mind-files, Knowledge-Sync (Session vs Custom Context, 5 classes UPDATE/ENRICH/ADD/NEW_FILE/INFO), Multi-Command session-log (1 file per command, full-notrunc default), /mind-compact template generator, plugin-independent Python backup-system installer (GFS+SHA-256+Rollback+Mutation-Guard). Claude Code CLI only. cygpath required (Git-Bash/MSYS2).
